timing: Specified before benchmark generation and any comparative evaluation; Phase 1 files remain frozen.

A.specification: Future independently implemented journey-aware Pareto baseline: use shared road durations for all destinations, hard structural eligibility, nondominated rent/commute/size alternatives; prespecify deterministic tie handling on development profiles before final evaluation. Not a reproduction of trajectory-based reachability or inaccessible original algorithms.

B.selection: Highest preference; ties resolved by original request order; retain selected destination's commute bound and travel frequency. Single-destination profiles unchanged on this dimension.

C.specification: Stratified random common eligible homes plus varied areas/types/rents/structural matches and near-boundary negatives, with explicit sampling provenance stored separately. Add future baseline nominations by pair union; never depend exclusively on proposed Top-K. Pooled labels estimate relevance within judged pool, not whole-market recall. Record unjudged rate and pool-incompleteness sensitivity.

D.specification: Human labels collected before outcome analysis; no model-derived pseudo-ground-truth. Any future model-assessment-visible condition must be separate and prespecified.

additional_clarifications.location_ablation: Future criterion-only ablation keeps shared commute-feasible pool; end-to-end no-routing condition separately removes constraints. Do not interpret the confounded Phase 1 condition as criterion-only evidence.
additional_clarifications.candidate_designs: End-to-end methods start from frozen inventory with their declared eligibility stages. Controlled ranking shares hard-and-commute eligible pool; neither pool is KNN-selected. Area-first is not forced into proposed Top-K.
additional_clarifications.sparse_profiles: Retain and report zero/small eligible sets; do not force ten results. Sparse cases support coverage diagnostics, not claims of competitive Top-10 ranking.

changelog.action: Add four authorized refinements and explicit candidate/annotation safeguards; no existing protocol overwritten.
